source_text: Τὸ δὲ δίδοται, φησίν, τισὶ λόγος, ὅτε συμφέρει ἀπολογεῖσθαι, ἵνα διὰ τῆς ὁμολογίας ὠφελῶνταί τινες καὶ ἰσχυροποιηθῇ ἡ ἐκκλησία.
pass_a_gloss: But the is-given, he-says, to some word, when it-is-beneficial to-defend, in order that through the confession they-may-be-benefited some and may-be-strengthened the church.
pass_b_english: “It is given,” he says — a word is given to some when it is useful to make a defense, so that through the confession some may be helped and the church strengthened.
